arguments.where_clause: merchant_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE mcc = 5311)
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose merchant is in merchant category code 5311 (department stores), whatever the amount, card or transaction type.
assumptions: Department stores means merchants whose mcc is exactly 5311; no amount, card type or transaction type condition is added.
Flagging is based on the merchant's MCC in the merchants table, so every transaction at a 5311 merchant is included.
